_readme: Recursive $refs that tools/sync-ucp-schemas.php could not flatten, per protocol version. GeneratedSchemaValidator resolves only local pointers, so the sync tool inlines every cross-file $ref; a $ref that points back into its own chain cannot be inlined and is replaced with a schema accepting all seven JSON types. That is a subtree which stops being validated, and it is silent, so the count is recorded here and the sync fails if it grows. Raise a budget deliberately and say in the commit message what stopped being validated. At 2026-04-08 the single cut is shopping/types/payment_instrument.json's self-reference at $defs/selected_payment_instrument; nothing $refs that entry, so the placeholder is currently inert. The 2026-08-25 type graph is markedly more recursive (location, geo, policy, constraint_expression, payment_schedule), which is what this number exists to catch.
